name: window-door-designer
description: 门窗设计软件 - 2D设计 / 3D预览 / 材料库 / 自动算料 / 报价订单 (Windows + Web + Android)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @wdd/schema && npm run build --workspace @wdd/core && npm run build --workspace @wdd/web
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @wdd/desktop && npm run build --workspace @wdd/server
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @wdd/schema && npm run build --workspace @wdd/core && npm run dev --workspace @wdd/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @wdd/schema && npm run build --workspace @wdd/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
